prompts.closed:
Use case: ui-mockup. Make a tightly scoped revision to the attached Rose Pocket mobile business-card website. ONE completed mobile website screenshot with the same 935 x 1683 rendered pixel dimensions and tall aspect ratio as input. This is the CLOSED / IN-SLEEVE state. No phone bezel, browser chrome, OS bar, annotations or comparison collage.
Preserve the selected design: soft blush page, warm dark-plum type, rich textured ivory cotton-stock card, dusty rose physical sleeve with semicircular notch, folded edges, soft shadows, hello. and A card from Luis sleeve text, small Lift card action printed lower-right. Preserve the carefully aligned lower section: two matching side-by-side Save contact and Add to Apple Wallet actions, separate full-width email row hello@luis.app with icon and arrow, then aligned GitHub / LinkedIn / Writing footer. No new elements or style changes.
APPLY EXACTLY THESE USER-REQUESTED TOP CHANGES:
1. REMOVE the embossed LA monogram from the business card COMPLETELY. There must be NO logo, watermark, seal or decorative monogram anywhere on the cream card.
2. Remove the whole empty vertical band that previously contained that card logo. Start the identity row roughly 24 logical px below the card's top edge. Do not leave a blank space in its place.
3. Keep one and only one LA logo: at the TOP LEFT OF THE PAGE in the existing header position. Change this from flat dark-plum printed ink to a beautiful tactile BLIND EMBOSS pressed/raised into the blush page. It is the SAME elegant interlocking serif mark: tall L whose horizontal foot crosses through the A at the A's middle. Use blush-on-blush relief, soft illuminated raised edge and a fine warm shadow; clearly legible as emboss, not solid dark ink, no patch or medallion background. Keep the Sacramento, CA header on the right.
4. The compact identity row is a small rounded-square REAL portrait on the LEFT and the name on the RIGHT as exactly TWO lines:
Luis
Augusto
Use elegant dark-plum serif around 29-31 logical px with close but clean leading, left-align both name lines. The two-line name block should have approximately the SAME HEIGHT as the portrait, roughly 68-72 logical px. Vertically align them so their tops and bottoms balance. Keep 16 logical px between portrait and name. Preserve the real face from the reference without replacing or stylizing the person.
5. Beneath this identity row, retain "Product & Growth Engineering" on ONE unbroken full-width line at readable 14 logical px. Keep a modest 12px gap, no title wrap.
6. This reduces vertical space: the cream card's visible upper section must be appreciably SHORTER. Bring the sleeve upward by roughly 50 logical px and bring all download/contact/footer content upward by the same amount while retaining their accepted internal widths, gaps, hierarchy and ordering. Don't compensate by adding empty padding above the portrait. Keep the sleeve's existing height and composition.
Exact copy remains unchanged except Luis Augusto is now on two lines. Preserve the paper texture and embossed visual realism. Maintain large enough touch areas and readable type. No decorative elements filling the freed space. The result is the same design, calmer and more compact, with the logo only embossed into the page header.
